proposals.downside_risk: Might increase RPC payload complexity if dynamic fees are constantly requested for every SHADOW quote.

evidence.detail: _validate_shadow_entry uses a static configuration for estimated_entry_fee_sol (default 0.00002) which ignores dynamic priority fees in fast markets.

proposals.expected_effect: More accurate representation of net-PnL and execution costs during SHADOW testing.
proposals.rationale: Accurate SHADOW PnL requires dynamic infrastructure fee awareness. Fast market conditions usually spike priority fees, turning marginally profitable leaders into net-loss trades if static fees are assumed, thus misclassifying an EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE cost as a HEALTHY setup.
proposals.shadow_test: Record dynamic priority fee estimates (e.g. from Jupiter's API or recent block averages) instead of a hardcoded 0.00002 SOL during SHADOW PnL validation.

proposals.downside_risk: eth_estimateGas calls might fail or revert if the simulation state is inconsistent with the real execution block, requiring fallback handling.

evidence.detail: _estimated_gas_native uses a static 250,000 gas units fallback for accounting, bypassing actual eth_estimateGas validation.

proposals.expected_effect: Will prevent false-positive SHADOW buys on high-gas-cost tokens, improving net P&L realism.
proposals.rationale: Static gas units fail to capture the infrastructure execution cost of high-tax or complex proxy tokens. A lack of eth_estimateGas leads to optimistic entry validations, blending EXECUTION gas failures into MARKET models.
proposals.shadow_test: Execute eth_estimateGas for all prospective SiBot EVM BUY/SELL operations during SHADOW mode and log the deviations against the 250,000 fallback.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote SiBot strategies directly to LIVE
rejected_ideas.reason: Prohibited by architectural review constraints; no fresh runtime forensics are available.

summary: Architectural review completed in the absence of fresh runtime forensics. The EVM and Solana SiBot engines successfully isolate leader signals, perform FIFO trade reconstruction, and implement round-trip slippage/deterioration gates. However, fixed execution cost estimates on both chains mask real-world network infrastructure variance (Solana priority fees, EVM gas constraints), which risks inflating SHADOW PnL and blending EXECUTION failure with MARKET loss.
